description.zh: 角色三视图提示词依次写：复用用途、换装不变的身份锚点、一套造型、侧背面的识别点、按比较内容选的光，并写明画面内不画标签和箭头。附AI漫剧可复制模板和6个原创范例。
description.en: A character turnaround sheet prompt states its purpose, one outfit, side and back anchors, lighting chosen for comparison and no labels. Plus 6 examples.

answer.zh: 角色三视图提示词先写这张板给后续镜头复用什么，再写换衣服也不变的身份锚点、唯一一套当前造型，以及正面、侧面、背面各靠哪个锚点认人。光线按要比较的内容选，背景只求不干扰识别，并写明画面内无视图标签、箭头和图注。
answer.en: A character turnaround prompt states what later shots will reuse the sheet for, then gives identity anchors that survive a costume change, one current outfit, and the anchor that identifies the character in each view. Choose lighting by what needs comparing, keep the background from competing with recognition, and rule out labels, arrows and captions.

heading.zh: 角色三视图提示词模板（可复制）
heading.en: Character turnaround sheet prompt template

body.zh:
身份和造型由创作者在视觉设定里先定好；视图、光线、背景和排除项按这张板的用途来挑，项目或创作者另定了版式时从项目。身份还没定，就先列出候选请创作者拍板，别用文案糊过去。

| 字段 | 写什么 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| 用途 | 下游要靠这张板保持什么：认人、认这套衣服、认某个状态或某个部位 | 下游镜头的复用需要 |
| 身份锚点 | 少量换装后仍成立、看得见、彼此不重复的特征，如轮廓、比例、一个局部标记、一组颜色或材质关系 | 视觉设定（已确认） |
| 当前造型 | 从头到脚只写一套，先写剪裁、层次、领口袖口、材质和主次色，再写气质 | 视觉设定（已确认） |
| 视图 | 为用途挑最少够用的视图；多个视图必须是同一时刻、同一造型 | 按用途选，项目有固定版式时从项目 |
| 侧背锚点 | 侧面和背面各由哪个锚点承担识别 | 从已确认锚点里挑，逐个视图核对 |
| 光线 | 让要比较的结构看得清的光 | 按要比较的内容选 |
| 背景 | 不抢识别的纯色或简洁背景 | 按用途选，创作者可改 |
| 保持与排除 | 这张板最容易多出来或漂走的东西 | 这张板的漂移风险 |

### 可复制的三视图提示词骨架

1. 【项目风格标签】人物设定参考图，用于后续镜头认出〔角色名〕和〔这套造型／这个状态／某个部位〕。
2. 身份锚点：〔换衣服也不变的可见特征：脸型、发际、体型、永久痕迹、长期配饰〕。
3. 当前造型：〔从头到脚只写一套：发型整理方式、上衣、下装、鞋、配饰及其佩戴位置〕。
4. 视图：同一时刻、同一造型的〔正面／左或右侧面／背面〕全身视图并排，等高，自然站立，表情〔平静／低强度〕；侧面选锚点所在的那一侧。
5. 侧面与背面：〔哪几个锚点在侧面、背面也要看得见，例如扎起头发后露出的后颈标记、肩背轮廓〕。
6. 光线：〔五官位置用均匀正面光；骨骼体积用侧光；布料纹理用大面积柔光；剪影用轮廓光〕。
7. 背景：〔不干扰识别的纯色或简洁背景〕。
8. 版面：画面内无视图标签、无引线箭头、无尺寸标注、无图注。
9. 保持与排除：〔这张板最可能多出来的东西，如第二套衣服、手持道具、新伤、模板审美句〕；不出现可读文字。

填完删掉空项、括号和“身份锚点：”“视图：”这类字段名，读起来像一段能直接交给画师的工作说明。多角色时每个角色单独写一条，只有对比板才把几个人放进同一张；角色名与视觉设定里的登记名一致。风格标签按项目统一前置，例如【真人风格，写实风格】或【国漫风，二次元画风】，设计描述本身不带风格词。
body.en:
Identity and outfit come from the approved visual spec; the sheet's purpose sets views, lighting, background and exclusions unless the project or creator fixes a layout. If identity is undecided, give the creator options to choose from.

| Field | What to write | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| Purpose | What later shots must keep | What later shots reuse |
| Identity anchors | Traits surviving costume changes | Approved visual spec |
| Current look | One outfit, head to toe | Approved visual spec |
| Views | Fewest views, same moment | Purpose or project layout |
| Side and back anchors | The anchor each view uses | Approved anchors, checked per view |
| Lighting | Light that shows the comparison | What needs comparing |
| Background | Plain, non-competing backdrop | Purpose; creator may override |
| Keep and exclude | Likely intrusions and drift | This sheet's drift risks |

### Copyable turnaround prompt skeleton

1. [Project style tag] Character reference sheet for recognizing [name] in [this outfit / state / body part].
2. Identity: [face shape, hairline, build, permanent marks, long-term accessories].
3. Look: [one outfit head to toe, with accessory positions].
4. Views: [front / left or right side / back] full-body, same moment and look, side by side at equal height, standing relaxed, calm; pick the side that shows the anchor.
5. Side and back: [anchors that must show there, e.g. a nape mark, the shoulder line].
6. Lighting: [even front light for features; side light for bones; soft light for fabric; rim light for silhouettes].
7. Background: [plain color].
8. Layout: no view labels, no leader arrows, no dimension marks, no captions.
9. Exclude: [second outfit, hand props, new injuries, template beauty phrases]; no readable text.

Delete empty slots, brackets and field names such as "Identity:" to leave a working brief. Write one prompt per character (comparison sheets excepted), named as in the visual spec, style tag first.

heading.zh: 6 个角色三视图提示词范例
heading.en: Six filled character turnaround prompt examples

body.zh:
六个范例用同一部江边轮渡题材的[漫剧](/glossary/manju)：售票员苗秋禾二十出头，船老大宋满仓六十岁出头，两人的身份和造型已在视觉设定里确认。

### 范例 1：全身三视图（身份板）

> 【国漫风，二次元画风】人物设定参考图，用于后续镜头认出苗秋禾和她的售票造型。二十出头的女性，圆脸，下巴短，眉距略宽，左耳垂一颗小黑痣，肩窄，上背微圆。齐肩黑直发在脑后扎低马尾，露出后颈右侧一块指甲盖大小的浅褐胎记；藏青立领短外套拉链拉到胸口，内搭浅灰圆领针织衫，右小臂套一只橙色布袖套，深灰直筒裤，黑色平底帆布鞋。同一时刻、同一造型的正面、左侧面、背面全身视图并排，三者等高，自然站立，双手垂在身侧，表情平静。均匀柔和的正面光。浅米色纯色背景。画面内无视图标签、无引线箭头、无尺寸标注、无图注。不加首饰，不拿票夹或任何道具，不出现可读文字。

全身三视图靠体态和轮廓认人：背面看上背弧度、马尾和后颈胎记，侧面看上背弧度和马尾；耳垂痣留给范例 2。袖套写明“右小臂”，三个视图就不会各戴各的。

### 范例 2：头肩面部识别板

> 【国漫风，二次元画风】苗秋禾头肩面部识别参考图：圆脸，下巴短，眉距略宽，左耳垂一颗小黑痣，齐肩黑直发扎低马尾，发际线完整露出。正面头肩与左侧面头肩两个视图（露出左耳垂）并排等高，表情平静。均匀的正面平光，浅米色背景。画面内无视图标签、无引线箭头、无图注。只画到领口，不表现服装全貌。

平光让五官位置好比较，代价是脸部体积变平；服装交给范例 1。

### 范例 3：服装造型板（正面加背面）

> 【国漫风，二次元画风】宋满仓船上工作装参考图，用于核对衣服层次和挂件位置。六十岁出头的男性，个子矮，腿短，腰身粗，肩膀宽厚，方下巴，花白寸头。他穿褪色的深蓝帆布马甲，敞着怀，里面是洗白的军绿长袖衫，袖口卷到小臂中段，腰后右侧别一条旧白毛巾，黑色胶鞋，裤脚塞进鞋口。正面与背面全身视图并排等高，头身比例按他本人的矮壮体型，双臂自然下垂。大面积柔光，看清帆布磨白的纹理和毛巾的垂挂位置。浅灰背景。画面内无视图标签、无引线箭头、无图注。马甲上没有文字或标志。

毛巾别在腰后，正面看不到，所以补背面；层次靠正背两面已够核对，侧面省掉。

### 范例 4：状态板（同一造型加包扎）

> 【国漫风，二次元画风】苗秋禾状态参考图，沿用她的售票造型：圆脸、耳垂痣、低马尾、右小臂袖套和整套衣服保持不变，只在右手掌缠一圈白纱布，结打在虎口一侧，四根手指露出。正面全身一个视图，右手自然抬到腰前，让包扎可见，表情平静。均匀柔光，浅米色背景。不加血迹或其他伤口，不换衣服，不出现可读文字。

起因和有效范围（第 6 集缆绳擦伤，到第 8 集为止）记在条目信息里，正文只写变化和保持项。

### 范例 5：不合模板身材的角色（全身三视图）

> 【国漫风，二次元画风】人物设定参考图，用于后续镜头认出宋满仓本人。六十岁出头的男性，个子矮，腿短，腰身粗，肩膀宽厚，方下巴，花白寸头，右手小指缺了末节。他穿船上工作装：深蓝帆布马甲敞穿，军绿长袖衫卷袖，腰后右侧别一条旧白毛巾，黑色胶鞋。同一时刻、同一造型的正面、右侧面、背面全身视图并排等高，头身比例按他本人的矮壮体型，不拉长腿部，双臂自然下垂。高位斜侧光，让方下巴、肩背厚度和腰腹体积在侧面清楚可比较。浅灰背景。画面内无视图标签、无引线箭头、无尺寸标注、无图注。

矮壮是他的识别点，写进视图句，免得模板里的“修长”把他拉高；侧光让体积可比较。

### 范例 6：剪影对比板（漫剧远景用）

> 【国漫风，二次元画风】剪影对比参考图，用于远景和逆光镜头分清苗秋禾与宋满仓。两人并排，宋满仓比苗秋禾矮约半个头，各一个右侧面全身视图：苗秋禾窄肩，上背微圆，脑后低马尾在轮廓上形成一个小凸起；宋满仓矮而宽，肩背厚，寸头轮廓平，腰后毛巾在轮廓外垂出一角。深色纯色背景，轮廓光勾出外形与发型剪影。画面内无标签、无箭头、无图注。

轮廓光会把脸压进暗部，所以这张只做剪影对比，认脸仍靠范例 1 和 2。
body.en:
All six examples share one [motion comic](/glossary/manju) on a river ferry: ticket seller Miao Qiuhe (early twenties) and captain Song Mancang (early sixties), both approved in the visual spec.

### Example 1: full-body turnaround (identity sheet)

> [Chinese anime style] Character reference sheet for recognizing Miao Qiuhe in her ticket-office look: early twenties, round face, short chin, wide-set brows, small mole on the left earlobe, narrow shoulders, rounded upper back. Low ponytail showing a light-brown birthmark at the right of the nape; navy stand-collar jacket over a grey knit; orange sleeve protector on the right forearm; dark trousers; canvas flats. Front, left-side and back full-body views, same moment and look, side by side at equal height, standing relaxed, calm expression. Even soft front light, light-beige background. No view labels, leader arrows, dimension marks or captions; no jewelry, props or readable text.

Full-body views read build and outline, so the earlobe mole is left to Example 2; naming the right forearm keeps the sleeve protector on one arm.

### Example 2: head-and-shoulders face sheet

> [Chinese anime style] Face reference for Miao Qiuhe: round face, short chin, wide-set brows, small mole on the left earlobe, low ponytail, full hairline visible. Front and left-profile head-and-shoulders views, left earlobe visible, equal height, calm expression. Even flat front light, light-beige background. No labels or captions.

### Example 3: outfit sheet (front and back)

> [Chinese anime style] Work-outfit reference for Song Mancang: short, stocky man in his early sixties, grey crew cut. Faded canvas vest, open, over an olive shirt with rolled sleeves; white towel tucked at the back right of the waist; black rubber boots. Front and back full-body views at equal height. Large soft light to show the worn canvas and the towel. Light-grey background. No labels, captions or logos.

The towel is hidden from the front, so the back view earns its place.

### Example 4: state sheet (same look, bandaged hand)

> [Chinese anime style] State reference for Miao Qiuhe in her ticket-office look, all unchanged except white gauze wrapped once around the right palm, fingers free. One front full-body view, right hand raised to the waist, calm expression. Even soft light, light-beige background. No blood, other wounds or readable text.

The cause and range (rope burn, episodes 6 to 8) go in the entry's metadata.

### Example 5: a body that breaks the template

> [Chinese anime style] Character reference sheet for recognizing Song Mancang: short, short-legged, thick-waisted man in his early sixties, heavy shoulders, square jaw, grey crew cut, right little fingertip missing, in an open canvas vest, olive shirt, white towel at the back right of the waist and rubber boots. Front, right-side and back full-body views at equal height, true to his stocky build, legs kept short. High three-quarter side light to show jaw, shoulder depth and waist volume. Light-grey background. No labels or captions.

### Example 6: silhouette comparison sheet (for wide shots)

> [Chinese anime style] Silhouette comparison sheet for telling Miao Qiuhe and Song Mancang apart in wide and backlit shots. Side by side, Song about half a head shorter, one right-side full-body figure each: she has narrow shoulders, a rounded upper back and a ponytail bump; he is short and wide, with a flat crew-cut outline and a towel corner past his waist. Plain dark background, rim light tracing the outlines. No labels or captions.

Rim light hides faces, so this sheet only compares silhouettes.

heading.zh: 三视图提示词为什么先写用途
heading.en: Why a turnaround prompt starts with its purpose

body.zh:
用途决定后面每个字段：近景认脸做面部识别板，全身调度里认衣服做全身板并补上必要的背面，跨镜头复用的状态单独做状态板。背景和视图数量不属于角色身份，按用途挑。

人物板要让后面的镜头认出同一个人此刻的这一套状态。一张身份板只保一个身份、一套自洽的造型，几套造型、几种情绪不挤进同一张；要比较两个角色，另做对比板（见范例 6）；一次抬手、一个眼神属于镜头，交给分镜和[视频提示词](/drama-skills/seedance-prompts)。
body.en:
Purpose drives every field: a face sheet for close-ups, a full-body sheet (plus a back view where needed) for outfits, a state sheet for states that recur across shots. Background and view count follow purpose too.

Keep one identity and one look per identity sheet, give a two-character comparison its own sheet (Example 6), and leave gestures and glances to the storyboard and the [video prompt](/drama-skills/seedance-prompts).

heading.zh: 三视图侧面和背面靠什么认人
heading.en: What identifies a character in side and back views

body.zh:
正面看得到整张脸，侧面只剩侧脸，背面看不到脸。逐个视图问一遍：观众凭什么认出她？

- 正面：脸型、五官的相对位置、正面可见的配饰。
- 侧面：面部侧轮廓、上背弧度和站姿重心、发型剪影；痣或胎记只在它所在的那一侧看得见，要写明画左侧面还是右侧面。
- 背面：发际形状和发型剪影、肩背线的宽窄与重心、后颈的永久痕迹。

锚点必须在那个视图里真的看得见。眉距、瞳色、唇形这类只在正脸看得清的特征撑不起侧面和背面；Drama Skills 做人物设定时，要求侧面和背面各有至少一条认得出的锚点。全身视图靠体态和轮廓认人，面部小标记留给近景和头肩板。

视图之间常见的毛病是变脸、换衣服、配饰挪位置，比如右臂的袖套到背面跑到左臂；把佩戴位置和相对大小写进三个视图共用的造型句。跨镜头的连续性见 [AI 短剧角色一致性](/drama-skills/character-consistency)。

漫剧如果主要靠剪影认人，锚点不换，只换画法：发际形状落到发型剪影的缺口上，体态落到肩背重心上。找不到可靠画法时交回创作者，别换一个更好画的身份。
body.en:
The front view shows the face, the side a profile, the back none. Ask of each view what lets the audience recognize the character there.

- Front: face shape, feature layout, accessories seen from the front.
- Side: profile, upper-back curve and posture, hair silhouette; a mole or birthmark shows only on its own side, so name the profile.
- Back: hairline shape and hair silhouette, shoulder line and weight, permanent marks on the nape.

An anchor counts only if that view shows it. Face-on features such as brow spacing or lip shape cannot carry the side and back; Drama Skills asks for at least one anchor for each. Full-body views read build and outline; small facial marks belong to close-ups.

Drift between views is a common failure, such as a sleeve protector that jumps arms; pin accessory positions in the shared look sentence. For consistency across shots, see [character consistency in AI short drama](/drama-skills/character-consistency).

In a silhouette-driven motion comic, keep the anchors and redraw them (hairline as a notch in the hair shape, posture as shoulder weight), or ask the creator.

heading.zh: 三视图提示词要不要写“正面”“侧面”标签？
heading.en: Should a turnaround sheet prompt include view labels?

body.zh: 标签不要画进板里。这张板之后要当参考图用，板上的字会带进后面的镜头，提示词里再加“不要文字”也清不掉，要先裁切、清理、遮罩或换参考图。多视图并排时直接写“画面内无视图标签、无引线箭头、无尺寸标注、无图注”，再写清几个视图、怎样并排、是否等高。
body.en: Keep labels off the sheet. It becomes a reference for later shots, and a later "no text" cannot remove text already on a reference; it would need cropping, cleaning, masking or replacing. For side-by-side views, write "no view labels, no leader arrows, no dimension marks, no captions" and give the view count and whether they share one height.

heading.zh: 三视图用什么光：按要比较的东西选
heading.en: Turnaround sheet lighting: choose by what you need to compare

body.zh:
每种光让一类结构看得清，同时压掉另一类，所以先问这张板要比较什么。

| 要比较什么 | 选什么光 | 代价 |
|---|---|---|
| 五官相对位置、妆面、服色和图案 | 均匀正面光 | 颧骨、鼻梁、下颌的体积变平 |
| 骨骼体积和轮廓起伏 | 侧光或高位斜侧光 | 暗侧细节丢失，左右不对称被放大 |
| 布料纹理、肤质 | 大面积柔光 | 轮廓边界变软 |
| 磨损、金属反光、工艺痕迹 | 小面积硬光 | 过渡丢失，瑕疵被放大 |
| 发型剪影、服装廓形 | 轮廓光或逆光边缘光 | 面部信息被压掉，不能单独当身份板 |

顶光让眼窝、鼻下、颌下的纵向结构可比较，代价是暗区里的识别细节和服装层次会丢；底光颠倒日常明暗，做识别板时不用。状态板可以用场景里的实际光源，光向要和已确认的场景一致。

光型只按要比较的内容挑，“女角色一律柔光、男角色一律侧光”这类按性别、年龄、贫富或题材套用的默认，先删掉。强戏剧阴影遮住脸或服装结构的图，不能当识别板。
body.en:
Pick light by what the sheet must compare; each setup reveals one structure and hides another.

| What to compare | Lighting | Trade-off |
|---|---|---|
| Feature layout, makeup, clothing colors | Even front light | Face volume flattens |
| Bone structure and contour | Side or high three-quarter light | Shadow-side detail lost |
| Fabric and skin texture | Large soft light | Outlines soften |
| Wear, metal, craft marks | Small hard light | Flaws exaggerated |
| Hair and garment silhouette | Rim or backlight | Face detail lost |

Top light makes the eye sockets, nose and jaw comparable but loses detail and clothing layers in shadow; skip under-lighting for identity sheets. A state sheet may use the scene's practical light if its direction matches the approved location.

Delete defaults keyed to gender, age, wealth or genre, such as "soft light for women, side light for men". Dramatic shadows over the face or clothing structure disqualify an identity sheet.

heading.zh: 三视图提示词里的九头身等模板词为什么会改掉角色
heading.en: How template phrases like nine-heads-tall proportions overwrite a character

body.zh:
人物板模板如果给每个角色都挂上同一串审美句，比如“九头身、修长双腿、完美五官”，遇到和已确认身份冲突的角色，身份优先，模板让位。宋满仓矮壮腿短，挂上“九头身”就成了另一个人；又因为这句话出现在每张板上，下游会把它当作画风统一。本来就修长的角色，也要由自己的锚点写出修长。

排查办法：把一批角色的提示词摆在一起，找出逐字重复、又和身份无关的句子。能追溯到某个角色当前视觉设定的留下，追溯不到的删掉，或改写成这个角色真实的锚点。

“网红脸、顶级美女、8K、杰作”同理，挤掉锚点又给不出可核对的事实。审美词要么落到构图、材质或光向这类看得见的选择上，要么删掉。
body.en:
When a template attaches the same beauty phrases to every character, such as "nine-heads-tall proportions, long slender legs, perfect features", some will clash with approved identities, and identity wins. "Nine-heads-tall" turns stocky Song Mancang into someone else, and because it sits on every sheet, it passes for a consistent style.

To audit, line up a batch of prompts, find word-for-word repeats that say nothing about identity, and keep only what traces to a character's visual spec.

"Influencer face, 8K, masterpiece" work the same way: tie an aesthetic word to a visible choice such as framing, material or light direction, or cut it.

heading.zh: 三视图提示词常见错误与改法
heading.en: Common turnaround prompt mistakes and fixes

body.zh:
- 一张板里出现两套衣服、两种发长或干湿并存：只绑一套造型，其他造型拆成独立条目。
- 手持道具和当下表情写进了身份：道具需要反复识别时才单独建板，表情交给分镜；身份板表情平静或低强度。
- 表单字段直接贴进正文，比如“角色：船老大／年龄：60”：改写成自然描述。
- 生成结果漂移后原样重发同一段描述：先判断是身份、构图、文字还是状态出了问题，再改对应的那一句。

发出前用这张清单过一遍：

- [ ] 第一句写了用途和角色名
- [ ] 身份锚点换衣服后仍然成立
- [ ] 整张板只有一套造型
- [ ] 每个视图都有看得见的锚点
- [ ] 光线对应要比较的内容
- [ ] 写了画面内无标签、箭头、尺寸标注和图注
- [ ] 没有与身份冲突的模板审美句
body.en:
- Two outfits, two hair lengths, or wet and dry on one sheet: bind one look and split the rest into separate entries.
- A hand prop or passing expression in the identity: give the prop its own sheet only if later shots must recognize it; expressions go to the storyboard.
- Form fields pasted in, such as "Role: captain / Age: 60": rewrite them as plain description.
- Drifting output answered by resending the same prompt: find whether identity, composition, text or state failed, and fix that sentence.

Checklist before sending:

- [ ] First sentence states purpose and name
- [ ] Anchors survive a costume change
- [ ] One look on the sheet
- [ ] Every view has a visible anchor
- [ ] Lighting matches the comparison
- [ ] No labels, arrows, dimension marks or captions
- [ ] No template phrase conflicts with identity

q.en: Does a turnaround sheet need a white background?

a.zh: 不用。Drama Skills 把白底三视图当作一种项目选择；浅灰、浅米等纯色或带环境的背景都可以，只要不干扰识别，也不把一次性的场景光和陈设写进身份。
a.en: No. Drama Skills treats a white turnaround as one project choice. Grey, beige or an in-context background works if it stays out of the way and no one-off scene light or set dressing enters the identity.

q.zh: 三视图提示词用中文还是英文写？
q.en: Should I write turnaround prompts in English or Chinese?

a.zh: 跟随项目设定。Drama Skills 的可复制正文按项目配置 `short-drama.json` 里的提示词语言输出；没有这份配置时默认英文，同一任务里保持一种语言。
a.en: Follow the project setting: Drama Skills writes the copyable prompt in the language set in `short-drama.json`, defaults to English without it, and keeps one language per task.

q.zh: 角色受伤或换衣服要重做三视图吗？
q.en: Do I need a new turnaround when a character is injured or changes clothes?

a.zh: 身份三视图不用重做。换装或伤势会跨镜头出现、影响识别时，先在视觉设定里登记成新的造型版本或状态版本，再写造型板（新衣服）或状态板（只写变化和保持项）；只在一个镜头里出现的，写进那一镜的分镜。
a.en: Keep the identity turnaround. If the change recurs across shots or affects recognition, record it as a new look or state in the visual spec, then write a look sheet (new outfit) or state sheet (change plus what stays). A one-shot change goes in that shot's storyboard.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /short-drama-image-prompts 为 EP001 已确定的人物写三视图提示词”（Codex 里写作 `$short-drama-image-prompts`）。它把带 `IMG-...` 编号的可复制正文存进 `剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md`，本身不生成图片；出图要转 `short-drama-produce`，确认具体任务后才执行。
text.en: In Claude Code, ask: "Use /short-drama-image-prompts to write turnaround prompts for the approved characters in EP001" (in Codex, `$short-drama-image-prompts`). It saves copyable `IMG-...` entries to `剧集/<EP>/图片提示词.md` without generating images; generation goes through `short-drama-produce` after you confirm the exact task.

title.zh: Seedance提示词怎么写：起点、动作链、终点三步写法
title.en: Seedance prompt guide: turn short drama shots into video prompts

seo_title.en: Seedance Prompt Guide: 2.0 vs 2.5 Video Prompts

description.zh: Seedance提示词按起点、因果动作链、终点来写，机位和台词放在它发生的那一拍；2.5 多镜用首尾相接、铺满时长的时间段，2.0 用动作顺序和镜头序号。
description.en: Write Seedance prompts as start state, causal action chain, end state. Seedance 2.5 uses timed segments that fill the clip; 2.0 uses shot numbers.

answer.zh: Seedance提示词先写这一镜的可见起点，再按因果顺序写动作链，最后落到能核对的终点，机位、声音和台词放在各自发生的那一拍上。Seedance 2.5 多镜或长叙事用整数秒时间段，各段首尾相接，铺满总时长。Seedance 2.0 正文不写时间戳，单镜按动作先后写，多镜标“镜头1、镜头2”。
answer.en: Write a Seedance prompt from the shot's visible start state, through a causal chain of actions, to an end state you can check, with camera, sound and dialogue on the beat where they happen. For Seedance 2.5 multi-shot takes, use integer-second segments that butt end to end and fill the duration. For Seedance 2.0, leave timestamps out: write actions in order and number multiple shots.

heading.zh: Seedance提示词要写哪几项？七项清单
heading.en: What goes into a Seedance prompt: a 7-part checklist

body.zh:
Drama Skills 的运动配方里有一张可执行检查表，写完提示词可以逐项对照，标准是 Seedance 只凭这段文字就能生成，不用替你做任何决定。第三列是示例写法。

| 要写的项 | 漏写的后果 | 示例写法 |
|---|---|---|
| 起手状态 | 开场姿势由模型挑，和上一镜接不上 | 她坐在窗台上，左手握着半杯凉茶 |
| 按先后排的动作，每步带方向 | 几个动作叠在一起，分不清先后 | 接着把杯子放到窗台外沿；随后双脚落地 |
| 至少一处量级 | 幅度由模型定，每次重生成都变 | 双脚落地前上身前倾约二十度，杯子放在离窗沿约一掌处 |
| 一条并行通道，用“与此同时”标出 | 只剩一个人在动，或者全场一起乱动 | 与此同时，窗帘被风掀起一角 |
| 结束状态 | 结尾由模型即兴收场，下一镜没有起点 | 最终她背靠窗框站定，杯子留在窗台上 |
| 摄影机，加一句要让观众看清什么 | 机位乱飘，无理由的运镜会被随手换掉 | 固定中景，全程不动，让观众看清杯子离手 |
| 台词原样放在说出口的那一拍 | 嘴型错位，或台词变成画面上的字 | 双脚落地这一拍：{她用中文说：“那我自己去。”} |

七项连起来就是一条可以直接套用的句式：

`首先［起手状态］；接着［动作、方向、幅度］；随后［动作带来的结果］；与此同时［另一条通道］；最终［结束状态］。机位［固定，或一条有动机的运动］，让观众看清［什么］。［哪一拍］{角色用中文说：“台词”}`
body.en:
Drama Skills' motion recipe has an executability check for each prompt: could Seedance produce the shot from this text alone, deciding nothing for you?

| Part | If it is missing | Example line |
|---|---|---|
| Start state | The model picks its own start and the cut breaks | She sits on the windowsill, a mug of cold tea in her left hand |
| Ordered actions with directions | Actions blur and the order is unreadable | Then she sets the mug on the outer ledge; next both feet touch the floor |
| At least one magnitude | Move size drifts from take to take | Before her feet land she leans forward about twenty degrees |
| One parallel channel, marked Meanwhile | One person moves alone, or everyone moves at once | Meanwhile the curtain lifts at one corner |
| End state | The ending is improvised and the next shot loses its start | Finally she stands against the frame, the mug left on the sill |
| Camera, plus what the viewer should see | Framing drifts, and the model swaps in any move you did not motivate | Locked medium shot, so we see the mug leave her hand |
| Dialogue, verbatim, on its beat | Lip sync misses or the line becomes on-screen text | On the feet-down beat: {She says in English: "Then I'll go myself."} |

Chained together, the seven parts give a fill-in pattern:

`First [start state]; then [action, direction, size]; next [its result]; meanwhile [one other channel]; finally [end state]. Camera [locked, or one motivated move], so we see [what]. On [beat]: {Character says in English: "line"}`

heading.zh: Seedance视频提示词的核心：起点、动作链、终点
heading.en: How Seedance prompts work: start state, action chain, end state

body.zh:
起点和终点由分镜定好，提示词只读不改，只负责中间的变化：谁在什么触发下做了什么，最后停在哪里。分镜怎样定起止，见[已有剧本怎样直接做分镜](/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard)；起始画面的规格见[冻结关键帧](/glossary/dongjie-guanjianzhen)。

### 起点：用此刻的静态状态写

起点写成此刻定格的画面，“他正要推门”已经把后面的动作提前写了进来。只写开始运动必须知道的事：重心和朝向、目光落点、哪只手拿着什么，以及离门、桌子或旁人有多远。

图生视频有真实参考帧时，长相、服装、场景陈设交给图片，正文只写左右手、持物、要动的关节和视线。文生视频没有图，人物、造型、地点、构图和光线都要写进正文。跨镜保持同一张脸见[AI 短剧角色跨镜一致](/drama-skills/character-consistency)。

### 动作链与表演：用触发串起来

每一步写清谁、做什么、朝哪、碰到什么、到达什么状态，再用因果连起来：先听见或看见，视线转过去，手停下，最后身体才动。“缓缓、自然、电影感”说不出动作往哪走、走多远；情绪落到呼吸、注视、停顿或手上的动作，把“紧张地等”写成手指停在杯沿、呼吸变短、目光两次扫向门口。

一条提示词最好只承担一个主导的戏剧变化。交接、追逐、身份揭示和大范围特效挤在同一镜时，回到分镜拆开。

### 摄影机与声音：机位要有动机，声音排成一条时间线

机位要么固定，要么只走一条有动机的路径：什么时候开始动、往哪动、停在什么景别。Seedance 同一次生成画面和声音时，把本镜全部对白、画外音和音效按先后写成一条声音时间线，事件之间回到写明的底声或静默。

### 终点：写完逐项对照

把终点和分镜逐项对照：姿态、位置、目光、双手、持物。全部一致才算完成。提示词漏了哪项就补哪项；结尾确需改动，回分镜环节去改，提示词里不另写结尾。
body.en:
The storyboard owns each shot's start and end; the prompt treats both as read-only and owns the change in between. See [building a storyboard from an existing screenplay](/drama-skills/script-to-storyboard) for how those are set, and [frozen keyframe](/glossary/dongjie-guanjianzhen) for the start frame.

### Start state: a still, present-tense frame

Write the start as a frozen present moment; "he is about to push the door" smuggles in a future action. Include only what the motion needs: weight, facing, gaze, what each hand holds, and distance to doors, tables or people.

In image-to-video, the reference frame carries face, costume and set; the text covers hands, props, moving joints and gaze. Text-to-video has no picture, so state character, costume, location, framing and light. See [character consistency in AI short drama](/drama-skills/character-consistency).

### Action chain and performance: link steps by trigger

Each step names who acts, the action, direction, contact and resulting state, chained by cause: a sound or sight, then the eyes, then the hand, then the body. Words like "slowly", "natural" and "cinematic" never say where anything moves or how far. Put emotion into breath, gaze, pauses and hands: "waits nervously" becomes fingers stopping on the cup rim and eyes flicking to the door twice.

Aim for one dominant dramatic change per prompt; split anything bigger in the storyboard.

### Camera and sound: a motivated camera, one sound timeline

Lock the camera, or give it one motivated path: trigger, direction, ending shot size, and what the viewer should see. When audio is generated in the same pass, write dialogue, voice-over and effects as one ordered sound timeline, with room tone or silence between events.

### End state: check it field by field

Compare the end with the storyboard: pose, position, gaze, hands, props. Fill any field the prompt missed; if the ending itself must change, change the storyboard.

heading.zh: Seedance 2.5 提示词：时间段要铺满整个时长
heading.en: Seedance 2.5 prompts: timed segments must fill the duration

body.zh:
Seedance 2.5 接受整数秒时间戳，还区分参考、编辑、延长三类任务，需要单独的写法。

- 短单镜按“主体、动作、场景、光色、运镜、风格、约束”写，镜内时机靠先后和触发表达，句子里写的秒数（如“第 2 秒回头”）落点会有偏差。
- 多镜或长叙事每段写成 `镜头 1 [0:00–0:03]：`，段与段不重叠、不留空档，最后一段的终点等于总时长。
- 超出时长的部分会被截掉，段尾动作、台词和终点姿态一起丢。少于时长同样出问题：剩下的秒数会被模型用你没写过的动作、表情或运镜填满，要把余量分给已有段落，或补一段落住反应的收尾。
- 超出和留白分开查：中间空一段加尾巴超一段，总数可能刚好对上。逐段核对前一段的结束秒等于后一段的开始秒，最后一段的结束秒等于镜头时长。
- 时间戳仍有生成偏差，逐字口型和精确剪辑点要在生成后回听、实测。
- 素材每次出现都写明它负责什么，比如 `人物 @图片1`、`@视频1 的表演节奏`，别让一个素材顺带把身份、动作、构图全管了。
- 终点状态很关键时，按分镜终点做一张尾帧，和起始帧一起分别放进首帧、尾帧两个位置（接口里是 `first_frame` 和 `last_frame`，各收一张图）。
- 编辑任务写“保留 A、B，只修改 C”；延长任务写“在 @视频1 的基础上续写 N 秒”，再从原视频的实际终点往下写。提示词意图要和提交的任务类型一致。
body.en:
Seedance 2.5 takes integer-second timestamps and separate reference, edit and extend tasks.

- Short single shot: subject, action, setting, light, camera, style, constraints. Time actions by order and triggers; seconds written into sentences land imprecisely.
- Multi-shot or longer takes: write each segment as `Shot 1 [0:00–0:03]:`, with no overlaps, no gaps, and the last segment ending at the total duration.
- Overrun is cut, taking the tail action, dialogue and end pose with it. Falling short is as bad: the model fills spare seconds with moves you never wrote. Give them to a segment or add a closing hold.
- Check overrun and gaps separately: a mid-clip gap plus an end overrun can sum to the right total. Each segment's end must equal the next start, and the last end the shot length.
- Timestamps still drift; check lip sync and cut points by listening to and measuring the output.
- Restate each asset's job at every mention, such as `character @Image1`, so no single asset steers identity, motion and framing at once.
- When the end state matters, make an end frame from the storyboard's end and put the two images in the first-frame and last-frame slots (`first_frame` and `last_frame`, one image each).
- Edit: "keep A and B, change only C". Extend: "continue @Video1 for N seconds", described from the source clip's actual last frame. The prompt's intent must match the task type.

heading.zh: Seedance 2.0 视频提示词怎么写：动作顺序加镜头序号
heading.en: Seedance 2.0 prompts: action order and shot numbers, no timestamps

body.zh:
火山引擎官方的 [Seedance 2.5 提示词指南](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/2607689) 对比过两版的时间控制：2.0 认镜头序号，不认时间戳。Drama Skills 的 2.0 写法照此处理，秒数留作内部预算，正文只写先后。

- 用中文按“主体、动作细节、场景、光色、运镜、视觉形态、约束”的顺序写，看得见的具体事实放在前面，画质类形容词只留必要的。
- 单镜直接按动作发生的顺序写，节奏用“开头保持一拍”“话音落下后”“结尾停住”这类相对说法表达。
- 一次生成多个镜头时才用 `镜头1：`、`镜头2：`，每个镜头都写清谁、在哪、做什么、镜头怎么动。
- 切点落在哪一秒由模型决定，正文里写的秒数管不住它。需要精确切点时，两镜分开生成再剪。
- 对白写成 `{角色用中文说：“逐字台词”}`，音效写成 `<声音>`，音乐写成 `（音乐）`，2.5 用同一套符号。不要字幕时，在正文里直接写明全程不出字幕。
- 素材每次提及都重复绑定，如 `人物 @图片1`。接着上一段实际生成结果往下拍时，写“向后延长 @视频1”，并用 `@图片1` 指向那段视频的实际尾帧。
body.en:
Volcengine's official [Seedance 2.5 prompt guide](https://docs.volcengine.com/docs/82379/2607689) (in Chinese) compares time control in both versions: 2.0 follows shot numbers and ignores timestamps. Drama Skills follows that note: seconds stay an internal budget and the text gives only order.

- Order: subject, action detail, setting, light and color, camera, visual style, constraints. Lead with visible facts; keep quality adjectives few.
- Single shot: actions in order, with relative pacing such as "hold a beat" or "after the line lands".
- Several shots in one generation: `Shot 1:`, `Shot 2:`, each with who, where, what and camera.
- The model picks where the cut falls, whatever seconds you write; for an exact cut, generate the shots separately and edit.
- Dialogue as `{Character says in English: "exact line"}`, naming the spoken language; effects as `<sound>`, music as `(music)`; state "no subtitles" plainly. 2.5 uses the same marks.
- Re-bind the asset at every mention. To continue a real clip, write "extend @Video1" and point `@Image1` at its actual last frame.

heading.zh: Seedance提示词示例：同一组镜头的 2.5 版和 2.0 版
heading.en: Seedance prompt example: one sequence written for 2.5 and 2.0

body.zh:
设定：末班公交进站，司机正要熄火，最后一排传来手机震动。分镜两镜共 8 秒：镜头 1 司机回头，5 秒；镜头 2 空座上的手机，3 秒。文生视频，不要字幕。

2.5 版的时间段首尾相接，到 0:08 正好是总时长；文生视频要写出司机的样子和穿着，台词只在声音时间线里出现一次：

> 镜头 1 [0:00–0:05]：夜里的末班公交停在终点站，车厢灯全亮。四十岁上下的男司机穿深蓝色工作服，坐在驾驶座，右手捏着插在锁孔里的钥匙，左手搭在方向盘上，视线落在前挡风玻璃。车厢后部传来震动声，他的视线先移到车内后视镜；接着右手松开钥匙，上身向右后方转约四十五度；与此同时，车外站台的灯箱熄灭；最终他侧身定住，左手仍搭在方向盘上，看向最后一排，随即开口，口型与台词同步。固定中近景，从前门一侧平视，全程不动，让观众看清他松开钥匙的那只手。
> 镜头 2 [0:05–0:08]：同一节车厢的最后一排，空座位上一部手机屏幕朝上亮着，随震动在座面上挪动约一指宽；随后震动停下，屏幕仍亮着。固定近景，略俯拍座面。
> 声音时间线：全程底声是发动机怠速的低鸣；司机转头前，车厢后部响起<手机震动声>；司机定住后：{司机用中文说：“谁的手机？”}；镜头 2 开头<手机震动声>再响一次，停下后回到怠速低鸣。全程无字幕、无对白文字叠加。

Seedance 2.0 版只改两处：方括号里的时间段去掉，写成 `镜头1：`、`镜头2：`；镜头1 的起点句后面加“开头保持一拍”。改完的开头是这样：

> 镜头1：夜里的末班公交停在终点站，车厢灯全亮。……视线落在前挡风玻璃。开头保持一拍。车厢后部传来震动声……

其余照 2.5 版保留。2.0 不认时间戳，5 秒、3 秒只是内部预算，要卡准切点就把两镜分开生成再剪。
body.en:
The setup: the last bus pulls in, the driver is about to switch off, and a phone buzzes in the back row. Two shots, 8 s: the driver turns (5 s), then the phone on an empty seat (3 s). Text-to-video, no subtitles.

Seedance 2.5 version: segments butt end to end to 0:08; with no reference image, the driver's look goes in the text, and the line appears once, in the sound timeline:

> Shot 1 [0:00–0:05]: Night. The last bus stands at the terminus, cabin lights on. The driver, a man around forty in a navy work jacket, sits at the wheel, right hand on the key in the ignition, left hand on the wheel, eyes on the windshield. A buzz from the back; his eyes go first to the rear-view mirror; then his right hand lets go of the key and his upper body turns about forty-five degrees to the right and back; meanwhile the lit sign at the stop outside goes dark; finally he holds, half-turned, left hand still on the wheel, looking at the back row, and speaks, lips matching the line. Locked medium close-up, eye level from the front-door side, so we see the hand leave the key.
> Shot 2 [0:05–0:08]: Same bus, back row. On an empty seat a phone lies screen up and lit, nudged about a finger's width by the buzzing; then the buzzing stops and the screen stays lit. Locked close-up, slightly high angle.
> Sound timeline: engine idle hum throughout; before the driver turns, a <phone buzzing> from the back; once he holds: {Driver says in English: "Whose phone is that?"}; at the start of Shot 2 the <phone buzzing> once more, then back to the idle hum. No subtitles or dialogue text overlays at any point.

For Seedance 2.0, change two things: drop the bracketed times and label the shots `Shot 1:` and `Shot 2:`, and add "Hold a beat." right after Shot 1's start state. 2.0 ignores timestamps, so the 5 s / 3 s split is only your budget; for an exact cut, generate the shots separately and edit.

heading.zh: Seedance提示词常见错误与改法
heading.en: Common Seedance prompt mistakes and how to fix them

body.zh:
- **只有形容词**：把“缓缓、电影感”换成方向、幅度和结果。
- **动作全挤在同一刻**：从触发开始串成链，“与此同时”只留给一条不冲突的通道。
- **正文混进文件名、版本号、锁定标记**：它们可能变成画面里的字，留在工作卡片里。
- **台词放不下就加快语速或删字**：回分镜延长或拆镜；改台词回剧本环节。
- **文生视频只写“保持原有外观”**：模型没收到图，把人物、造型、地点和光线写进正文。
body.en:
- **Adjectives only** (slowly, cinematic). Replace with direction, magnitude and result.
- **Everything at once.** Start the chain on a trigger; give Meanwhile to one non-conflicting channel.
- **File names, version numbers or lock markers in the prompt.** They can show up as text in the picture; keep them in working notes.
- **Speeding up or trimming dialogue to fit.** Lengthen or split the shot in the storyboard; change lines in the script.
- **"Keep the existing look" in text-to-video.** The model has no image; describe character, costume, location and light.

q.en: How long should a Seedance prompt be?

a.zh: Drama Skills 的经验是把七项清单写满约两百字，超过三百字多半有重复。删减时靠合并景别、机位和角度，保住逐字台词和声音。
a.en: Drama Skills' Seedance profiles default to Chinese prompts, aiming for about two hundred characters across all seven parts; past three hundred usually means repetition. Merge shot size, position and angle; keep dialogue and sound.

q.en: Does Seedance 2.0 support timestamps in prompts?

a.zh: Drama Skills 按官方说明处理：2.0 响应镜头序号，不响应时间戳。单镜按动作先后写，多镜用“镜头1、镜头2”，需要精确切点就分开生成再剪。
a.en: Drama Skills follows the official note that 2.0 responds to shot numbers and ignores timestamps. Write actions in order, number multiple shots, and generate separately when a cut must be exact.

q.en: How do first and last frames work in Seedance 2.5?

a.zh: 首帧、尾帧两个位置各放一张图；终点状态关键时，按分镜终点做尾帧。两张帧图也占图片序号，`@图片N` 按素材顺序连续往下数。首尾帧能否再混用其他参考图，要按接口文档核对并实测，中间的动作仍要看成片检查。
a.en: Put one image in each of the first-frame and last-frame slots; when the end state matters, build the last frame from the storyboard's end. Both frames take image numbers, so `@ImageN` keeps counting in asset order. Check the API docs before mixing frames with other references, and check the in-between motion on the output.

text.zh: 在 Claude Code 里说：“用 /short-drama-video-prompts 把 EP001 的分镜一镜一条写成视频提示词”（Codex 里写作 `$short-drama-video-prompts`）；还没有分镜就先用 `short-drama-storyboard`。项目档案没有目标模型时点名“按 Seedance 2.5 写”，它会经 `short-drama` 记进档案再出稿；不用参考图要明说走文生视频，否则它会列出缺的参考图后停下。
text.en: In Claude Code, ask: "Use /short-drama-video-prompts to turn the EP001 storyboard into video prompts, one per shot" (in Codex, `$short-drama-video-prompts`). No storyboard yet? Run `short-drama-storyboard` first. Name the target model, such as Seedance 2.5, and it records it in the project profile through `short-drama` if missing; for text-to-video say so, or it lists the missing reference images and stops.
